text:
Event: Kelbury offsite, Tuesday. Capacity: 200.

Staffing:
- Dell out (rest of week); Leon covering.
- Mira out (rest of week); Esme covering.
- Suri/Leon swap desks; Ines/Teo swap desks.
- Coverage: Teo (Cora), Ines (Pia), Vik (Leon), Greta (Cora), Una (Kira), Ada (Wren), Jonah (Opal), Finn (Dell), Wren (Opal), Kira (Nils), Leon (Opal).

Room/Equipment:
- Coffee machines: Loading bay, garden studio, harbour room (working), print room, library annex, north office, east wing.
- Repainting: North office/East wing (evening); Library annex (morning); Print room (morning, expect noise); Garden studio (evening, expect noise).
- Lifts: Slow near loading bay/library annex, harbour room, garden studio, north office.
- Umbrellas: Garden studio, East wing, harbour room, print room. One in loading bay, one in harbour room. New in garden studio. Left in print room. One left in north office.
- Stand-ups: Morning in North office; Evening moved to East wing.

Preferences/Status:
- Esme: Library annex clear for visitors. Harbour room too cold afternoon.
- Ines: Loading bay clear (evening cold); print room too cold morning; asked if North office free afternoon.
- Hugo: East wing free afternoon? Harbour room free evening?
- Una: Prefers harbour room for reviews; thinks print room too cold afternoon. Asked if North office free morning. Asked if library annex free evening.
- Cora: Prefers North office for reviews; thinks loading bay too cold in morning.
- Teo: Prefers garden studio for reviews; print room cold evening; asked if East wing free evening.
- Nils: North office too cold in morning.
- Bram: Harbour room too cold in evening. Prefers print room for reviews. Asked if East wing free morning.
- Suri: Asked if print room free in evening.
- Ada: Wants loading bay kept clear for visitors.

Action Items:
- Send Mira, Dell, Kira, Suri, Cora, and Ines evening meeting notes.
- Send Teo evening meeting notes.
- Check with Wren, Opal, Rafe, Vik before respective meetings.
- Check if loading bay free afternoon (Pia/Jonah/Dell asked).
- Check if harbour room free morning (Jonah asked).
- Keep print room clear for Suri/visitors.
- Vik wants harbour room clear for visitors.
- Check if garden studio is free in the evening (Pia asked).
- Send Dell afternoon meeting notes.
- Send Greta afternoon meeting notes.
- Remind later that Bram prefers print room for reviews.
- Check with Suri before morning meeting.
- Send Ines evening meeting notes.
